instruction: Create copies of all Jupyter notebook files (*.ipynb) from anywhere within the current directory tree, maintaining the original folder hierarchy in a new "./backup" directory.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task variation that requires copying all .ipynb files to a backup directory while preserving directory structure. The evaluator checks that all files are copied to ./backup with structure preserved.
